cards.why: This is an engineering challenge because it involves applying standard meteorological insolation datasets and battery discharge models to correctly size solar-power photovoltaic systems.
cards.researchQuestion: How can photovoltaic power generation and battery storage sizing models be accurately calibrated using regional winter insolation data to prevent power failures in autonomous agricultural IoT stations?
cards.quote: We power each station from a 20 W solar panel and a 12 V lead-acid battery, but our energy budget calculation was done by hand and two cooperative clients report stations going dark

cards.why: This is a research challenge because building localized microclimate frost prediction models from sparse sensor network time-series data requires spatial meteorological modeling and machine learning.
cards.researchQuestion: What spatial interpolation and machine learning techniques can predict localized frost events using dense sensor network time-series data and regional topography features?
cards.quote: We measure soil temperature and air humidity but farmers keep asking us for an estimated date of first frost at their specific field location, not just the nearest official meteorological station

cards.why: This is a research challenge because it requires developing a physiological effort model that accurately captures non-linear energetic costs of steep micro-topography variations on cycling routes.
cards.researchQuestion: How can topographical gradient distribution and short-pitch elevation variance be modeled to accurately estimate cyclist physiological energy expenditure and perceived effort on hilly terrain?
cards.quote: Our route recommendation engine works well on flat terrain but dramatically underestimates physical effort on the Fruška Gora ridge trails — cyclists rated those routes as 40% harder

cards.why: This is an engineering challenge because it involves designing an automated test bench and closed-loop robotic or electronic adjustment mechanism for antenna calibration.
cards.researchQuestion: How can radio frequency signal sweep measurement and capacitor tuning be automated in a manufacturing test fixture to reduce calibration time for GPS hardware components?
cards.quote: Our GPS antenna assembly line has a manual calibration step that takes 4.5 minutes per unit and is the bottleneck; we produce 600 units a week but could sell 900

cards.why: This is not research because it is a corporate financial modeling, accounting restructuring, and investment readiness task.
cards.researchQuestion: What financial modeling structure and cohort-based customer lifetime value methodologies satisfy institutional venture capital investment criteria for software-as-a-service and hardware hybrid businesses?
cards.quote: We are trying to raise a Series A round of €2.8 million from a Vienna-based impact fund but our three-year financial projections have been rejected twice

cards.why: This is an engineering challenge because it involves optimising web GIS data delivery, vector tile rendering performance, and payload size reduction for mobile browsers.
cards.researchQuestion: How can spatial data delivery protocols and vector map rendering pipelines be optimised to achieve sub-second load times for complex geographic trail networks on mobile web browsers?
cards.quote: Municipalities that license our trail portal want to embed it in their official tourism websites with full white-label branding, but our current map rendering pipeline takes 3–4 seconds

cards.why: This is a research challenge because investigating low-temperature lithium battery electrochemistry limits and devising firmware-level power management strategies for cold-weather deployments requires scientific analysis.
cards.researchQuestion: What low-temperature discharge optimization and adaptive power management strategies can extend the operational lifespan of lithium battery-powered wireless sensor nodes during sub-zero winter conditions?
cards.quote: Baterije u stanicama zimi traju upola kraće nego leti, pa voćari moraju da ih menjaju usred sezone.

cards.why: This is a research challenge because deploying insect pest detection models on resource-constrained microcontrollers with energy-efficient image transmission requires embedded computer vision research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can embedded computer vision models for insect trap monitoring be compressed and executed on ultra-low-power microcontrollers under strict energy and wireless bandwidth constraints?
cards.quote: Voćari ručno broje leptire na feromonskim klopkama; hteli bismo da kamera na klopci to radi sama.

cards.why: This is a research challenge because establishing robust empirical links between multi-spectral satellite indices, agronomic variables, and final crop yield requires advanced crop growth modeling and machine learning.
cards.researchQuestion: What machine learning models and crop growth simulation techniques can accurately predict per-parcel crop yield ranges in mid-season using multi-spectral satellite vegetation indices and farm operation logs?
cards.quote: Farmers want a yield estimate per parcel by mid-June, but our maps only show crop vigour.

cards.why: This is a research challenge because untangling soil moisture signals from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) backscatter affected by surface roughness and vegetation cover requires advanced remote sensing research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can synthetic aperture radar (SAR) backscatter data be decoupled from surface roughness and crop canopy effects to derive reliable field-scale soil moisture estimates?
cards.quote: Ground truth for soil moisture costs too much: probes are expensive and we can't place them on every parcel.

cards.why: This is a research challenge because developing real-time dynamic vehicle and crew rescheduling algorithms that execute within minutes under severe network-wide constraints requires advanced operations research.
cards.researchQuestion: What constraint programming and heuristic search algorithms can solve real-time public transit vehicle and crew rescheduling within minutes during unexpected operational disruptions?
cards.quote: Our route optimisation engine re-solves the whole timetable overnight; when a bus breaks down at 7 AM and we need a new schedule by 7:15, the solver takes 40 minutes

cards.why: This is a research challenge because processing massive GPS time-series datasets to build accurate, real-time arrival time prediction models for public transit requires advanced spatio-temporal machine learning.
cards.researchQuestion: What spatio-temporal machine learning models can accurately predict real-time bus arrival times and passenger information ETAs using massive historical automatic vehicle location time-series data?
cards.quote: We are collecting AVL data from 340 buses — GPS pings every 10 seconds — but we have never used it to predict travel times; three Romanian municipalities are asking for passenger information screens

cards.why: This is not research because it is a legal, data governance, and trans-national compliance architecture problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What cross-border data governance and server infrastructure architectures satisfy both international transport licensing laws and conflicting national GDPR interpretation requirements?
cards.quote: The Hungarian side of our cross-border service requires licensing under Hungarian transport law and GDPR data-residency rules that differ from Serbian regulations

cards.why: Determining the unknown combination of thermal cycling, condensation, and vibration causing weld failures requires experimental investigation and material testing beyond standard engineering practice.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the combined effects of low-temperature thermal cycling, moisture condensation, and dynamic vibration loads on the fatigue life of mild steel welded joints in industrial cold storage environments?
cards.quote: Our conveyor frames crack at the weld joints after roughly 18 months of operation in chilled environments; we've replaced 14 assemblies under warranty this year and we can't reproduce the failure in our workshop because we test at room temperature.

cards.why: Refactoring existing PLC ladder logic into a modular library is a software maintenance and architectural task rather than answering a novel research question.
cards.researchQuestion: How can legacy PLC codebases in ladder logic be modularized into reusable libraries to enable efficient, centralized safety updates across multiple installations?
cards.quote: Our PLC programs for different customers are each a custom spaghetti of ladder logic; when we want to push a safety patch we have to touch 38 separate codebases and it takes three engineers two full weeks.

cards.why: This is a financial modeling and business forecasting task required for a bank loan application, which does not involve scientific or technical research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can historical financial accounts and project margin data be structured into a three-year cash-flow forecast with sensitivity analysis for banking due diligence?
cards.quote: We need a €2 million investment to open a second assembly hall, and our bank wants a three-year cash-flow model with sensitivity analysis that our CFO doesn't have the capacity to prepare before the Q3 deadline.

cards.why: Characterising harmonic emissions and applying standard line reactors is an applied electrical engineering task using known standards and mitigation techniques.
cards.researchQuestion: How can harmonic current emissions from industrial frequency drives be accurately measured and mitigated to comply with EN standards for low-voltage grids?
cards.quote: Noise from our servo drives is injecting harmonics back into client factory grids and we've had two complaints from clients whose measurement instruments were affected; we don't have the tools to characterise the emission spectrum properly.

cards.why: Improving predictive model accuracy under data sparsity constraints in unstructured legal texts requires advanced machine learning and data augmentation research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can semi-supervised learning and cross-lingual transfer learning improve case-outcome prediction accuracy when trained on limited, unstructured legal text corpora?
cards.quote: Our case-outcome prediction model achieves only 61% accuracy on commercial-dispute rulings from Serbian courts, which is barely better than a lawyer's gut feeling; we suspect the problem is that our training set has only 9,000 labelled decisions and courts don't publish enough structured data.

cards.why: This is a corporate legal restructuring and shareholder agreement negotiation task, which is outside the scope of scientific or technical research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can early-stage convertible note structures and shareholder agreements be legally reorganized to facilitate cross-border venture capital financing?
cards.quote: We are trying to raise a €2.5 million Series A round to fund expansion into the German legal market but all three venture funds we spoke to in Q1 said our cap table structure is too messy from the 2019 convertible note round; we need legal restructuring advice, not technology.

cards.why: Implementing sentence-level provenance tracking and confidence scoring in a multilingual retrieval-augmented generation legal context poses open technical challenges.
cards.researchQuestion: How can retrieval-augmented generation architectures provide fine-grained, sentence-level source provenance and dynamic confidence scoring in multilingual legal applications?
cards.quote: Law firm users copy our AI-generated research summaries directly into briefs without reading them, and twice this year the summaries contained an outdated precedent; we need a way to attach confidence scores and source provenance to every generated sentence.

cards.why: Scaling and re-architecting search infrastructure to handle millions of legal documents while maintaining API contracts is an advanced database engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can large-scale full-text and semantic search architectures be optimized to maintain sub-second response times for millions of indexed legal documents?
cards.quote: We store full-text court decisions for three jurisdictions and search response time has degraded from 0.4 seconds to 3.1 seconds since we crossed 2 million documents; our database engineers say we need a fundamentally different indexing architecture.

cards.why: Developing robust morphological normalization and script-tolerant indexing for heavily inflected, mixed-script languages like Serbian requires specialized computational linguistics research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can morphological analysis and script-invariant indexing be designed to handle highly inflected, mixed Latin-Cyrillic low-resource languages in search engines?
cards.quote: Our search misses answers because Serbian words change form (e.g. 'kartica', 'karticu', 'karticom') and users mix Latin and Cyrillic.

cards.why: Adapting automatic speech recognition to challenging telephony audio in a low-resource language requires advanced acoustic modelling and transfer learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automatic speech recognition models be effectively adapted to noisy, low-bandwidth telephony audio for low-resource inflected languages using minimal annotated datasets?
cards.quote: Clients want the bot on the phone too; speech recognition for Serbian is poor on call audio.

cards.why: Automating penetration testing reconnaissance workflows involves scripting and pipeline integration using established security tools rather than new security research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automated reconnaissance and vulnerability enumeration pipelines be structured to streamline continuous penetration testing for small business networks?
cards.quote: We run manual penetration tests that take our team about two weeks per engagement; clients are asking for continuous testing and retest after patches, but at our size we simply can't bill enough hours to make that sustainable — we need a way to automate at least the reconnaissance and vulnerability enumeration phases.

cards.why: Designing educational training curricula and measuring administrative staff knowledge retention is an instructional design and pedagogical task, not technical research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can technical cybersecurity remediation findings be translated into structured, measurable training modules for non-technical municipal staff?
cards.quote: Two municipalities hired us and then couldn't act on our findings because their IT staff didn't understand the remediation steps; we'd like a structured training programme we could sell alongside the audit, but writing curriculum and measuring knowledge retention is not something we know how to do.

cards.why: Navigating administrative paperwork and regulatory compliance procedures for government certification is purely a bureaucratic and legal compliance task.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the specific administrative and formal requirements for obtaining a certified information security auditor license under national regulatory frameworks?
cards.quote: We've been trying for five months to register as a certified auditor under the Serbian Information Security Law so we can bid on public procurement contracts, but the paperwork at the Ministry keeps bouncing back for minor formal reasons and we don't know how to fix it.

cards.why: Identifying the chemical or microbiological origin of sulphur compound generation in ion-exchange resin beds requires analytical chemistry and microbiology investigation.
cards.researchQuestion: What chemical or microbiological degradation mechanisms in ion-exchange resin batches lead to the periodic release of sulphur compounds in process water lines?
cards.quote: Three of our dairy clients have reported a sulphur smell in their process water after we installed new ion-exchange softeners; we've flushed and regenerated the resins but the problem reappears within two weeks and one client has threatened to cancel.

cards.why: Developing matrix-matched calibration standards or correction factors for handheld water test kits in high-hardness water is an applied analytical procedure.
cards.researchQuestion: How can matrix-matched calibration methods be formulated to correct measurement interferences in portable water test kits operating in high-hardness mineral waters?
cards.quote: Our portable turbidity and nitrate test kits give inconsistent readings in hard water above 450 mg/L CaCO₃; we calibrate with distilled water but field samples from Banat wells are much harder and the kits weren't designed for that matrix.

cards.why: Building a script-based generation layer on top of an existing tool API to convert System Extracts to ARXML files is an applied software tooling task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automated code generation scripts interface with AUTOSAR configuration tool APIs to translate system extracts into software component configurations?
cards.quote: We manually generate around 3,200 AUTOSAR software component configuration files per project and it takes two engineers three weeks; one of our competitors apparently automated this and turned around the same job in four days — at current rates we are losing bids on price.

cards.why: Generating automated interface test scenarios to uncover component interaction faults from formal component descriptions requires software testing and formal verification research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can interface specification models and ARXML descriptions be systematically analyzed to automatically generate test cases targeting boundary interaction faults between distributed software components?
cards.quote: Our test coverage reports show 87% branch coverage but we keep finding integration bugs in the CAN communication stack after delivery; we suspect the problem is at the boundary between components from different suppliers but we have no systematic way to find those interaction faults before shipping.

cards.why: Creating internal technical training modules and onboarding documentation for diagnostic protocols is an industrial training and HR development task.
cards.researchQuestion: What is an effective self-paced instructional curriculum and simulation environment for onboarding engineers into automotive diagnostic protocols and ECU flashing?
cards.quote: Three of our five engineers who do ECU flashing and diagnostic tooling learned on the job and have no formal training in UDS or OBD-II protocol internals; last year two of them left for a bigger company in Novi Sad within 18 months of joining and we had to restart their replacements from scratch — the training cost alone was over €25,000 each time.

cards.why: Migrating batch-oriented data processing pipelines to stream processing architectures for financial reconciliation is a complex distributed systems engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can distributed stream-processing pipelines be architected using Apache Kafka to achieve real-time payment reconciliation across multiple multi-provider datasets under strict consistency constraints?
cards.quote: Reconciliation jobs that match transactions across Stripe, Adyen, Klarna and local acquirers take up to 90 minutes to run for clients with 50,000 daily orders — merchants need the numbers closed before their morning finance meeting.

cards.why: Forecasting cash flows using short, limited time-series data combined with external or synthetic signals requires advanced time-series modeling research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can short-history financial time-series data be augmented with external macroeconomic or synthetic signals to accurately predict short-term merchant cash flows?
cards.quote: We want to add a cash-flow forecasting widget to the dashboard — merchants keep asking for it — but we only have 60 to 90 days of transaction history per client and seasonal patterns are hard to capture with that little data.

cards.why: This challenge concerns legal compliance, contract wording, and fundraising preparation rather than scientific research or engineering.
cards.researchQuestion: How can B2B SaaS payment reconciliation contracts balance GDPR data processor obligations and transaction data retention requirements?
cards.quote: Nalazimo se u procesu zatvaranja seed runde. Razgovarali smo sa sedam regionalnih investitora, od kojih su dva nezavisno ukazala da naš standardni ugovor sa merchantima

cards.why: Exporting electrical network data models into the standardized IEC 61968 format is a data mapping and interoperability engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can electrical utility asset inventories and network diagrams be systematically transformed to conform to the IEC 61968 Common Information Model standard?
cards.quote: We are tendering for EU-funded smart-grid projects in Hungary and Romania but our technical documentation is not meeting the IEC 61968 data-model requirements that the contracting authorities demand; we've lost two tenders in the last 18 months on documentation grounds alone.

cards.why: Investigating moisture condensation root causes under complex outdoor thermal-cycling conditions requires coupled heat and mass transfer analysis and environmental testing.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the coupled thermodynamic mechanisms of thermal cycling and internal heat dissipation driving moisture condensation inside outdoor electrical distribution enclosures?
cards.quote: Our switchgear enclosures are rated IP54 but field returns show condensation forming inside in about 8% of outdoor cabinets after two winters; we can't reproduce the failure reliably in our test room and we don't know whether it's a sealing design issue or a material issue.

cards.why: Extracting structured failure prediction models from unstructured, multilingual free-text maintenance logs requires advanced text mining and natural language processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can unstructured, mixed-dialect free-text maintenance logs in legacy databases be mined and classified to predict equipment failure probabilities for electrical distribution cabinets?
cards.quote: We have 14 years of maintenance logs from 600+ distribution cabinets, but it's all text in Serbian in a legacy database and nobody has ever extracted anything useful from it; we suspect the data could tell us which cabinet types are most likely to need a repair in the next 12 months.

cards.why: Solving large-scale shift scheduling optimization problems with complex skill constraints within strict time limits requires advanced combinatorial optimization and heuristic algorithm research.
cards.researchQuestion: What algorithmic optimization strategies can solve large-scale employee shift-scheduling problems with multi-skill constraints within near-real-time computational limits?
cards.quote: Our platform recommends shift schedules for shift-based clients, but when we run the optimiser on a plant with 340 workers and 28 skill categories it takes 6 hours to produce a two-week plan — clients want a result in under 20 minutes and we don't know how to cut the solve time.

cards.why: Validating and redesigning psychological wellbeing survey constructs against objective behavioral metrics like absenteeism requires psychometric and organizational behavior research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can employee wellbeing survey instruments be psychometrically validated and redesigned to robustly predict objective organizational outcomes such as absenteeism and turnover?
cards.quote: Our employee wellbeing survey module produces scores that line managers say feel arbitrary; one HR director showed us that two teams with identical scores had completely different absence rates, so the construct we're measuring probably isn't what we think it is.

cards.why: Providing legal opinions on labor codes and GDPR Article 88 compliance for metadata collection is legal counsel work, not scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the legal boundaries under the Slovak Labour Code and GDPR Article 88 regarding the collection of computer activity metadata as an employee productivity proxy?
cards.quote: We collect keyboard and application-usage metadata as a productivity proxy, but two clients in Slovakia have been contacted by their works councils saying this data collection may breach the Slovak Labour Code and GDPR Article 88 — we need a legal opinion fast or we could lose both contracts.

cards.why: Translating intangible HR engagement metrics into rigorous, defensible financial ROI models requires quantitative economic and organizational valuation research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can qualitative employee engagement metrics be methodologically translated into financially robust, auditable ROI models for corporate finance decision-makers?
cards.quote: When we present our platform to CFOs the conversation always stalls at ROI; we can show engagement scores going up but we have no rigorous way to translate that into a euro figure that a finance director will trust — we lose about one in three deals at this stage.

cards.why: Modeling the impact of high-frequency switching transients from variable-speed drives on voltage-regulation protection relays requires electromagnetic transient analysis and physical modeling.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the electromagnetic coupling mechanisms of high-frequency switching transients from variable-speed drives that trigger overcurrent protection trips in voltage regulators?
cards.quote: Our voltage-regulation device works well in steady state but when it encounters high-frequency switching transients from nearby industrial variable-speed drives, it trips on overcurrent about once a week per installation — we have oscilloscope captures but no model that predicts when this will happen.

cards.why: Speeding up Volt-VAR optimization solvers for large distribution networks within SCADA time cycles is a computational efficiency and algorithm optimization task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can semidefinite programming solvers for real-time Volt-VAR optimization be accelerated to execute within sub-three-minute cycles for large distribution networks?
cards.quote: We want to offer a real-time volt-VAR optimisation service across a feeder with 200+ nodes, but our current solver takes 4–6 minutes on a standard server, which is too slow to respond to the 5-minute SCADA update cycle the operators use.

cards.why: Navigating foreign energy regulatory compliance and product certification procedures in North Macedonia is a regulatory affairs and administrative advisory task.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the specific technical regulations, documentation formats, and laboratory testing procedures required for grid-protection equipment certification in North Macedonia?
cards.quote: We are expanding into North Macedonia and need to register our product as certified grid-protection equipment under their national technical regulations, but our legal team has no experience with Macedonian energy law and the process has been stuck for seven months.

cards.why: Imputing missing telemetry data in real-time power distribution state estimation while accounting for variable load contexts requires advanced time-series estimation and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can real-time state estimation algorithms accurately impute long telemetry data gaps caused by intermittent 4G cellular dropouts in rural electrical distribution networks?
searchTerms: power system state estimation missing data
cards.quote: Our field devices send telemetry over 4G but in agricultural areas signal drops cause gaps of 10–40 minutes in the measurement stream; the missing data corrupts our state-estimation results and operators lose confidence in the dashboard.

cards.why: Determining the specific oxidation pathway of unrefined cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil requires investigation beyond standard shelf-life testing.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the primary lipid oxidation pathways and key catalytic factors responsible for the rapid rancidity of cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil during ambient storage?
cards.quote: we have no idea what oxidation pathway is hitting us fastest

cards.why: This is an industrial design bottleneck involving mechanical filtration and fluid viscosity rather than fundamental new knowledge creation.
cards.researchQuestion: How can the filtration rate of crude cold-pressed oil be optimized through pre-clarification temperature control to prevent rapid filter press clogging?
cards.quote: the filter press is the bottleneck — it clogs every 90 minutes and cleaning takes 25 minutes each time

cards.why: This is an administrative and regulatory paperwork issue involving organic certification rather than technical R&D.
cards.researchQuestion: What administrative and protocol modifications are required to satisfy EU organic certification requirements for parallel processing facilities?
cards.quote: our current EU organic certification application has been sitting with the certifier for 11 months

cards.why: Solving workflow deadlocks and starvation under load requires formal verification or advanced static analysis of user-generated graph structures.
cards.researchQuestion: How can graph-based static analysis and runtime monitoring prevent deadlocks and worker starvation in asynchronous low-code workflow automation engines?
cards.quote: users in logistics companies keep building loops that deadlock under real load — support tickets about frozen workflows went from 12 to 67 per month

cards.why: Integrating multiple proprietary third-party APIs is an engineering and integration challenge rather than a scientific research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What software architecture patterns can minimize integration effort and standardize telemetry data ingestion across fragmented logistics telematics APIs?
cards.quote: integrating GPS telemetry from five different telematics vendors is taking our team six months per vendor

cards.why: This is a corporate sales coaching and language proficiency need rather than a technical or scientific problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can technical founders improve sales presentation delivery and objection handling in foreign-language enterprise environments?
cards.quote: we need professional sales training and presentation coaching, not more engineering

cards.why: Improving cross-lingual semantic similarity matching for highly specific financial and legal terminology requires advanced natural language processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multilingual semantic textual similarity models be adapted for cross-lingual budget line alignment in low-resource Slavic and Finno-Ugric administrative contexts?
cards.quote: the automatic cross-language consistency checker produces about 30% false positives when the same budget line is named differently in Hungarian and Croatian

cards.why: Fundraising and investor outreach are commercial business development tasks rather than research activities.
cards.researchQuestion: What financing strategies and pitch preparation methods are most effective for seed-stage software companies seeking venture capital in Central and Eastern Europe?
cards.quote: We need to raise a €400k seed round by Q1 next year to fund the next 18 months of development

cards.why: Interpreting legal admissibility of electronic records and eIDAS compliance across jurisdictions is a legal and regulatory compliance task.
cards.researchQuestion: What technical specifications and database architectures comply with eIDAS-derived electronic record admissibility standards across multi-jurisdictional frameworks?
cards.quote: we have no idea how to structure our database logging to satisfy that requirement across different national e-signature laws

cards.why: Developing a lightweight, real-time physics approximation for unstable load shifts in simulation environments requires novel applied physics modelling.
cards.researchQuestion: How can real-time rigid-body simulation engines approximate unconstrained load shifting and inertial dynamics on elevated forks within tight computational frame-rate limits?
cards.quote: our forklift-operator training simulator needs to model realistic load physics — right now a pallet on the forks behaves like it's glued on

cards.why: Translating raw eye-tracking scanpath coordinates into behavioural performance scoring models involves data science and human factors research.
cards.researchQuestion: What temporal pattern mining and machine learning methods can extract operator attention errors and hazard recognition failures from eye-tracking scanpath data?
cards.quote: we have the eye-tracking hardware but no one on the team knows how to turn scanpath data into a meaningful performance score

cards.why: Implementing particle systems via compute shaders or GPU instancing is an advanced graphics programming and software engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can GPU-instanced particle systems and compute-shader pipelines render real-time environmental particulate effects on low-power integrated graphics hardware?
cards.quote: our current particle system tanks the frame rate below 30 fps as soon as more than two machines are working simultaneously

cards.why: Establishing formal validation studies with control groups for vocational training standard certification is an institutional and regulatory process.
cards.researchQuestion: What methodological frameworks and institutional partnerships are required to validate crane-operator simulation modules against European vocational training standards?
cards.quote: We need to certify our crane-operator simulator module against a European vocational training standard and the certification body is asking for a formal validation study

cards.why: Adapting machine learning models across diverse international retail environments with limited local data requires domain adaptation and transfer learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can unsupervised domain adaptation and transfer learning techniques maintain high accuracy for real-time customer intent recognition models when deployed across geographically diverse retail environments?
cards.quote: the model we trained on Belgian retail data drops from 84% to 61% accuracy when deployed for a Romanian grocery chain

cards.why: Preparing algorithmic impact assessments and translating feature importance into compliance documentation for the EU AI Act is a legal and regulatory compliance task.
cards.researchQuestion: What documentation frameworks and explainable AI reporting formats fulfill EU AI Act transparency requirements for commercial churn-prediction models?
cards.quote: their data protection officer is asking for a full algorithmic impact assessment and documentation of feature importance in a form that satisfies the EU AI Act transparency requirements

cards.why: Resolving severe occlusion issues in computer vision object detection within cluttered retail environments requires advanced algorithmic research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can computer vision object detection and tracking architectures maintain robust people-counting accuracy under severe spatial occlusion caused by tall retail shelving?
cards.quote: the people-counting model confuses partially occluded shoppers with shelving units — in stores with tall gondola shelving the error rate reaches 22%

cards.why: Hiring international enterprise sales personnel and overcoming recruitment difficulties is a human resources and business management task.
cards.researchQuestion: What alternative market-entry and channel partner strategies can software companies use when local enterprise sales recruitment fails?
cards.quote: our current sales team has no German-speaking enterprise sales experience; we've been trying to hire a country manager for seven months without success

cards.why: Generating geometrically and visually plausible historic roof forms from basic building footprints requires algorithmic geometry and procedural modeling research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can procedural modelling and shape grammar rules generate visually accurate historic roof typologies from 2D cadastral building footprints in the absence of dense lidar point clouds?
cards.quote: the models look obviously wrong in historic city centres where buildings have irregular roof forms

cards.why: Developing real-time surrogate models to approximate complex Computational Fluid Dynamics simulations for interactive urban planning requires advanced machine learning and fluid dynamics research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can machine-learning surrogate models approximate urban microclimate CFD simulations (wind speed and shadow patterns) with interactive execution speeds?
cards.quote: nobody on our team has a background in fluid dynamics or microclimate simulation. We ran trials with two open-source CFD packages and one commercial solver, and the fastest run we achieved was about eight hours

cards.why: Resolving geodetic datum transformations and residual spatial offsets using standard GIS projection libraries is a spatial data engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What coordinate transformation pipelines and local grid shift parameters minimize residual spatial misalignments between MGI 1901 and ETRS89 cadastral datasets?
cards.quote: the coordinate transformation introduces visible misalignment of up to three metres in some regions, and we do not fully understand why

cards.why: Restating local statutory financial accounts into international financial reporting standards (IFRS) for corporate due diligence is an accounting and auditing service task.
cards.researchQuestion: What accounting procedures and revenue recognition standards are required to restate statutory SaaS financial statements into IFRS 15 and IFRS 16 compliance for venture capital due diligence?
cards.quote: our accountant has produced them in the Serbian statutory format and the fund's lawyers say they cannot use them without an IFRS restatement

cards.why: Retraining movement classification and injury-risk models on diverse demographic populations with distinct training loads and injury profiles requires sports science and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can accelerometer and gyroscope feature sets be adapted to accurately predict injury risk in amateur athletic populations with heterogeneous baseline conditioning?
cards.quote: our movement-pattern model was trained on professional-athlete datasets from Western Europe and the injury-risk scores it produces for our amateur users in Serbian regional leagues are uncorrelated with the actual injury events

cards.why: Redesigning information architectures and visual representations for specific non-technical user cohorts involves human-computer interaction and UX research.
cards.researchQuestion: What dashboard visualization paradigms and information architectures improve data comprehension and long-term retention among older, non-technical sports coaches?
cards.quote: Coaches tell us the dashboard is hard to understand — they spend more time figuring out what the charts mean than actually coaching, and our 30-day retention is only 19% among coaches over 40 years old

cards.why: Recruiting senior backend engineers in a competitive labor market is a human resources and compensation challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: What flexible engagement models and collaborative retention strategies can resource-constrained startups use to attract senior backend engineering talent?
cards.quote: We need to hire two senior backend engineers to handle the real-time data pipeline before the next season starts in August, but every candidate we approach is immediately counter-offered

cards.why: Optimizing chromatographic separation selectivity and yield for high-purity phycocyanin extraction requires biochemical process research.
cards.researchQuestion: What chromatographic stationary phases and elution protocols maximize phycocyanin purity and recovery yield while maintaining industrial cost-effectiveness?
cards.quote: Our phycocyanin purity after the first chromatography pass sits at around 70%, but buyers in the German nutraceutical market need 95%+ purity

cards.why: Developing dynamic lighting and thermal optimization models for microalgae cultivation in outdoor raceway ponds involves biological and environmental systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can dynamic LED supplemental lighting schedules optimize microalgae volumetric productivity and energy efficiency in unheated outdoor raceway ponds during cold-weather months?
cards.quote: Our outdoor raceway pond loses 30–40% of its productivity in October–March compared to summer — we tried supplemental LED lighting but the electricity cost wiped out the revenue gain

cards.why: Reviewing and drafting commercial supply agreements and IP assignment clauses is a legal and contractual task.
cards.researchQuestion: What contractual frameworks govern intellectual property ownership, facility audit rights, and liability allocation in international biotechnology supply agreements?
cards.quote: one buyer has already asked us to sign their standard terms, which we think are unfair but we can't afford a lawyer to review them

cards.why: Analyzing historical flag-and-outcome data to optimize laboratory middleware decision-rules and reduce unnecessary reflex reviews involves clinical data science research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can data-driven decision tree optimization reduce unnecessary laboratory reflex testing flags without compromising clinical sensitivity?
cards.quote: our middleware flags about 60 samples daily for manual technician review, but we estimate at least half of those reflex reviews are unnecessary

cards.why: Investigating veterinary-specific antimicrobial susceptibility breakpoints and interpreting atypical resistance profiles in Enterococcus strains requires veterinary microbiology research.
cards.researchQuestion: What specific antimicrobial susceptibility testing breakpoints and interpretive criteria accurately evaluate Enterococcus isolates from poultry livestock production?

cards.quote: What we do not have is any forecasting model or the in-house skills to build one. ... A working outcome would be a simple model that produces store-level daily demand estimates with reasonable accuracy

cards.why: Integrating post-quantum cryptographic algorithms into resource-constrained hardware security module firmware requires cryptographic engineering and embedded systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can post-quantum cryptographic signature algorithms (such as ML-DSA) be efficiently implemented and integrated into resource-constrained microcontroller firmware for Hardware Security Modules?
cards.quote: Our HSM firmware runs on a constrained microcontroller with limited flash and RAM, so a straight drop-in is not possible. We need a migration plan that tells clients which firmware version will support post-quantum algorithms

cards.why: Optimizing high-throughput database query performance and indexing strategies for multi-million row certificate revocation status checks requires database systems and performance engineering research.
cards.researchQuestion: What database indexing, partitioning, and caching architectures can sustain sub-150 millisecond OCSP response times for certificate revocation databases exceeding two million rows?
cards.quote: The revocation table has grown to about 2.1 million rows and our indexing strategy was designed when the table was a tenth of that size. ... A good outcome is sustained OCSP response times below 150 milliseconds at peak load

cards.why: Restating historical financial statements from local GAAP to IFRS standards for venture capital due diligence is an accounting and financial auditing task.
cards.researchQuestion: What accounting and valuation methodologies are required to restate multi-year financial statements from Serbian GAAP to IFRS for corporate venture capital compliance?
cards.quote: We have been reporting under Serbian GAAP since the company was founded, and our accounts are audited annually by a local firm in Novi Sad. We do not have IFRS statements, and we do not have in-house staff who know how to prepare them.

cards.why: Investigating and solving micro-fracturing in epoxy potting compounds under cyclic thermal stress for tamper-evident hardware security enclosures requires materials science and polymer chemistry research.
cards.researchQuestion: What polymer formulation and curing parameters prevent micro-fracturing in epoxy potting layers around printed circuit board assemblies under extreme thermal cycling from -10°C to 60°C?
cards.quote: During evaluation preparation, our mechanical team has been running thermal cycle tests and consistently finding micro-fractures in the epoxy potting layer after 50 to 80 cycles. ... We do not have materials science expertise in-house

cards.why: Investigating the physicochemical conditions governing soda ash formation on cold-process soap surfaces requires surface chemistry and surfactant science research.
cards.researchQuestion: What physicochemical mechanisms drive unreacted sodium carbonate crystallization (soda ash) on cold-process soap surfaces during saponification and curing, and how can they be reliably controlled?
searchTerms: soda ash formation cold process soap
cards.quote: About fifteen out of every hundred bars we unmould develop a white dusty coating on the surface within a day or two. ... We have tried spraying the tops ... None of these steps has brought the rate below about twelve percent consistently.

cards.why: Formulating stable cosmetic body butters using alternative local Vojvodina plant oils and analyzing fatty acid compositions and oxidation stability requires cosmetic chemistry and lipid science research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can local Vojvodina plant oils (sunflower, hemp, pumpkin seed) be formulated into stable body butter emulsions to match the rheological and skin-feel properties of shea and cocoa butter without rapid rancidity?
searchTerms: plant oil fatty acid profile cosmetic formulation
sunflower hemp seed oil body butter emulsion stability
cards.quote: Vojvodina has good sunflower, hemp and pumpkin-seed oil production and we can source those oils locally... The problem is we do not know enough about fatty-acid composition to know whether a reformulation will hold together properly

cards.why: Implementing user behavior tracking tools, heatmaps, and checkout funnel optimization on an e-commerce webshop is a web analytics and conversion rate engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What user experience and checkout flow modifications can reduce high cart abandonment rates on small-batch artisan cosmetic e-commerce platforms?
cards.quote: The problem is our abandoned-cart rate, which our WooCommerce dashboard shows sitting at seventy-one percent. We do not know what is driving it.

cards.why: Developing edge ML compression algorithms that preserve low-amplitude bearing-fault sidebands while reducing data volume requires novel signal processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can time-series vibration data from 4 kHz MEMS accelerometers be compressed at the edge on a resource-constrained microcontroller to preserve bearing-fault frequency-domain sidebands without increasing transmission costs?
cards.quote: Our vibration sensor on the gearbox generates 4 kHz raw signals; we are currently sending everything to the cloud and the data bill is already €18,000 a month at only 200 trucks — we cannot scale to 2,000 trucks without compressing or filtering at the edge first.

cards.why: Building multi-class fault attribution models from imbalanced historical time-series logs and sparse maintenance records is a complex machine learning research challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: What multi-class classification architecture can accurately distinguish specific drivetrain failure modes from sparse and imbalanced multivariate vibration telemetry?
cards.quote: We can detect that something is wrong with the drivetrain about 80% of the time, but our model cannot tell a worn differential from a failing wheel bearing — fleet managers need a specific fault code, not just a warning light, or they won't pay for the subscription.

cards.why: This is a legal compliance and contract drafting task regarding German employment and co-determination law rather than technical or scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can data processing agreements for commercial vehicle telematics be structured to comply with German works council (Betriebsrat) employee monitoring regulations?
cards.quote: We collect location and driving-behaviour data continuously from trucks; two German fleet operators have told us that before they sign, they need a data processing agreement that satisfies their works council and the German Betriebsrat co-determination rules around employee monitoring, which our Serbian lawyers have never dealt with before.

cards.why: Investigating thermal cycling micro-cracking and material degradation in epoxy potting compounds is an applied materials failure analysis task.
cards.researchQuestion: What failure mechanisms cause moisture ingress and PCB corrosion in epoxy-potted electronic enclosures subjected to aggressive automotive thermal cycling?
cards.quote: Our sensor housing is rated IP67 but after 18 months on trucks operating in winter conditions in Poland, about 4% of units show corrosion on the PCB, which we believe is caused by thermal cycling cracking the potting compound seal — we need to understand the failure mechanism before we can fix the next hardware revision.

cards.why: Developing robust optical characterization and automated text extraction for degraded, multi-lingual thermal parcel labels is an applied computer vision challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: How can optical characterization and text extraction pipelines reliably parse destination routing information from degraded, crumpled, or multilingual thermal-printed parcel labels?
cards.quote: Our depot sorting is still done by hand: two sorters misplace roughly 3–4% of parcels per shift, which costs us about 180,000 RSD a month in redeliveries and customer refunds. We need a way to read and route labels automatically even when they are crumpled, printed poorly, or in Hungarian.

cards.why: Designing real-time vehicle routing and dynamic re-optimization algorithms under frequent midday order cancellation and addition constraints is an operational research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can dynamic vehicle routing algorithms efficiently re-optimize last-mile delivery schedules in real time when facing continuous stochastic order modifications?
cards.quote: We have 34 drivers and dispatch is still done by one person on the phone every morning. When three or more orders cancel or are added after 10 a.m. we just can't re-optimise in time, and drivers end up doing 15–20% more kilometres than they should.

cards.why: This is an international trade compliance, tax regulation, and administrative consulting task rather than scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: What procedural frameworks and documentation templates are required to establish compliant B2C parcel logistics under the European Union One Stop Shop (OSS) VAT scheme?
cards.quote: We want to expand into Slovakia and Romania but do not have anyone on staff who understands the cross-border VAT and customs documentation for B2C parcels under the EU OSS scheme. Every consultant we talk to quotes us six months of work.

cards.why: Building thermal simulation models for refrigerated transport units to optimize pre-cooling and setpoints without compromising cargo safety is an applied thermodynamic research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can thermodynamic simulation models optimize pre-cooling schedules and dynamic temperature setpoints for refrigerated transport trailers to minimize fuel consumption while ensuring cold-chain integrity?
cards.quote: Our refrigerated trailers consume about 6.2 litres of diesel per hour just for the reefer unit, regardless of outside temperature or load volume. We've heard that smarter pre-cooling and setpoint management could cut that by 20–25%, but we have no way to model or test it without risking product temperature excursions for our pharmaceutical and food clients.

cards.why: Developing a rule-checking software tool to interpret tachograph data and driving-time regulations is a standard software engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What algorithmic rule-engine architecture can accurately monitor and forecast cumulative driving-time compliance under EU Regulation 561/2006 for cross-border logistics fleets?
cards.quote: Drivers on the Germany run are governed by EU Regulation 561/2006 tachograph rules, but our dispatcher still calculates driving-time compliance by hand on a spreadsheet. We've had two infringement notices in 18 months, each costing €3,200 in fines, and we're worried the next inspection will be worse.

cards.why: Automating root-cause attribution of temperature excursions across multi-stop multi-actor supply chains using heterogeneous spatio-temporal logs is a data integration and anomaly attribution challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: How can spatio-temporal telemetry logs and multi-vendor handover records be combined to accurately identify the specific transit segment and agent responsible for cold-chain temperature excursions?
cards.quote: About 1 in 20 of our groupage loads arrives with a cold-chain temperature excursion recorded by the datalogger, but we can't tell whether the breach happened at the shipper, at a transfer hub, or during line-haul. Without knowing where the break occurred we can't fix the process or defend ourselves in damage claims.

cards.why: This is a corporate accounting and financial statement formatting task required for bank loan applications rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can corporate accounting records be reformatted into structured five-year cash-flow projections compliant with development bank financing criteria?
cards.quote: We are trying to refinance the depot expansion through a Serbian development bank loan but the application requires a five-year audited cashflow projection in a format our accountant has never prepared. Two banks have already rejected the application on formal grounds.

cards.why: Developing scalable, sample-efficient quantum error mitigation routines to achieve chemical accuracy on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices is core quantum computing research.
cards.researchQuestion: What error mitigation strategy can reduce quantum noise in molecular simulation circuits while keeping computational shot counts within feasible limits to attain chemical accuracy?
cards.quote: Error mitigation on today's noisy quantum hardware for molecular simulation.

cards.why: Investigating radio frequency attenuation and propagation loss in dense agricultural crop canopies is an applied wireless communication research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How do dense agricultural canopies affect LoRa radio frequency propagation and packet loss, and what antenna or network topology modifications can ensure reliable telemetry in mature cornfields?
cards.quote: Our LoRa nodes send a packet every 15 minutes, but in dense corn canopy from July onward we see 30–40% packet loss even at maximum transmission power, and farmers are missing irrigation alerts during the hottest part of the season.

cards.why: Obtaining CE certification testing and setting up routine product labeling workflows are regulatory compliance and manufacturing operations tasks, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the standardized electromagnetic compatibility and environmental protection testing procedures required to secure CE marking for agricultural IoT sensor nodes?
cards.quote: We are still printing single-colour labels on our enclosures with a desktop printer and laminating by hand; distributors in Austria and Germany are asking for CE-marked labelling and multilingual quick-start cards, and our current process cannot scale past 200 units a month.

cards.why: Extracting predictive epidemiological rules linking multi-year microclimate sensor archives and messy farm-book records to pest and disease outbreaks is an applied machine learning and data science research task.
cards.researchQuestion: What machine learning models or threshold rules can accurately predict aphid and fungal outbreak risks from long-term historical microclimate sensor archives and farm management records?
cards.quote: We have 11 years of sensor readings paired with manual farm-book records, but we have never done anything analytical with that archive; we believe there is a pattern linking our microclimate data to local pest pressure but we do not have the people or tools to find it.

cards.why: Determining predictive relationships between multi-variable selective laser melting parameters and subsurface porosity in 316L parts is a materials science and statistical process optimization problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What multivariate regression or machine learning models can predict subsurface gas pores and lack-of-fusion voids in 316L selective laser melting builds using historical process parameters and coupon density logs?
cards.quote: Porosity in 316L parts fails customer pressure tests in about 1 of 12 builds.

cards.why: Formulating automated build scheduling and 3D geometry-dependent bin packing algorithms for additive manufacturing is an operations research and algorithmic problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multi-job nesting algorithms optimize platform fill rates and build schedules for multi-machine selective laser melting environments under strict geometric and delivery constraints?
cards.quote: Four printers, many small orders: we schedule builds by hand.

cards.why: Designing robust, human-interpretable explanation frameworks that satisfy rigorous regulatory audit trails for complex scoring models is a computational law and interpretable machine learning research challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: What interpretable machine learning explanation methods can provide verifiable, auditable decision trails for credit and insurance scoring models that satisfy multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance within strict latency bounds?
cards.quote: Our insurance-underwriting scoring model is challenged by regulators in three countries because auditors cannot follow why a specific applicant was declined; we need to show a clear, auditable reason for every individual decision or we lose the contract.

cards.why: Developing clinical coding anomaly detection models that reconcile subtle multi-parameter healthcare discrepancies is an applied health informatics and machine learning research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What machine learning architectures can effectively identify subtle clinical inconsistencies between diagnosis codes, procedures, and patient history in bulk health-insurance claims data?
cards.quote: We process health-insurance claims in bulk and about 3.2% of records contain diagnosis codes that don't match the procedure codes — our rules catch the obvious ones but nuanced clinical inconsistencies slip through and cost one client €420,000 in reimbursements last year.

cards.why: Recruiting skilled IT personnel and managing regional labor market shortages is an HR and recruitment task, not scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: What talent acquisition and organizational retention strategies can mitigate senior MLOps engineering shortages in regional technology hubs?
cards.quote: We're trying to hire two senior MLOps engineers but the market is completely dry — every candidate we interview either wants remote work for a Western company or is already at a bank; we've had the roles open for nine months.

cards.why: Building automated semantic compatibility and schema verification checkers for enterprise ERP integration pipelines is a software engineering research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automated schema analysis and semantic diffing techniques detect breaking changes in enterprise ERP system upgrades before connector integration failures occur?
cards.quote: Our ERP connectors break every time a German client upgrades their SAP instance — we spend roughly 600 developer-hours a year on reactive patches instead of new features, and three clients have already threatened to leave.

cards.why: Drafting standardized GDPR Article 28 data processing agreements and cross-border transfer compliance frameworks is a legal consulting task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can cross-border data processing agreements comply with GDPR Article 28 requirements when storing third-country non-adequate data?
cards.quote: We store EU client data in our Novi Sad data centre, but since mid-2023 four Dutch clients are asking for documented GDPR Article 28 processor agreements that our legal team cannot draft fast enough — we lost one contract already.

cards.why: Developing a dynamic configuration engine for document layout generation and brand-palette styling is a software engineering and template architecture task.
cards.researchQuestion: What dynamic layout engine architecture can render structured business reports across multiple international paper formats and brand palettes via configuration metadata rather than hard-coded templates?
cards.quote: Our analytics product generates PDF and Excel reports for clients, but the layout breaks on non-Western paper formats and brand guidelines vary per client — a senior designer spends two days per new client just on report templates.

cards.why: Fine-tuning multilingual transformer models for low-resource South Slavic language variants to score long argumentative student essays aligns with natural language processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: What fine-tuning strategies for multilingual transformer models can improve automated grading agreement with human evaluators on long argumentative student essays in South Slavic language variants?
cards.quote: Our automated essay-grading feature scores short factual answers decently, but as soon as students write longer argumentative texts — anything over 200 words — the agreement with human graders drops below 60%, which is not good enough for any of our university clients.

cards.why: Redesigning media server distribution and load balancing topologies for high-concurrency WebRTC streaming is a systems engineering and network architecture task.
cards.researchQuestion: What selective forwarding unit and media server load balancing architecture can scale live virtual classrooms beyond 100 concurrent participants without frame drops or server instability?
cards.quote: Live virtual classrooms on our platform crash or stutter for groups above 35 participants — our infrastructure team traced it to inefficient media server load balancing, but we lack the expertise to redesign the WebRTC architecture and every outside vendor we approached quoted over €80,000.

cards.why: Engineering predictive feature sets and interpretable machine learning models to detect student disengagement early with high precision requires applied machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: What interpretable machine learning features and predictive models can achieve high precision in early disengagement and burnout detection across large-scale learning management system telemetry?
cards.quote: We want to add a burnout-risk early-warning feature that flags students who are likely to disengage, but our current logistic regression model has a precision of only 54% on the validation set, which means teachers get too many false alerts and stop trusting it.

cards.why: Recruiting software engineering staff and managing regional talent deficits is an HR and recruitment challenge, not scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: What remote-hybrid collaboration models can sustain software product roadmaps during severe engineering staff shortages?
cards.quote: Two of our four senior backend engineers received better offers and left in the last quarter; we are now three months behind on our product roadmap and cannot find replacements willing to relocate to Novi Sad at the salaries we can currently offer.

cards.why: Developing geometric feature parsing and automated layout mapping algorithms for diverse packaging dielines is an applied computational geometry and automation task.
cards.researchQuestion: What computational geometry algorithms can automatically detect printable panels from vector dielines and map vector artwork within accurate bleed zones?
cards.quote: We produce roughly 600 packaging variants a year and our senior designer spends two days per project manually fitting artwork into structural dielines; we need a way to automate or semi-automate that layout step so turnaround drops from five days to two.

cards.why: Establishing a spectral measurement tracking protocol and lightweight database for cross-vendor print quality control is an applied quality assurance engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What measurement and tracking workflow can systematically compare spectrophotometric color readings across diverse print substrates and vendors to detect hue drift?
cards.quote: Clients are asking for colour consistency guarantees across offset, digital and large-format print, but our colour profiles drift between vendors and we have no systematic measurement process; we lost one retail contract last quarter because of visible hue shifts on shelf.

cards.why: Addressing regional wage gaps and recruiting specialized creative personnel is an HR and recruitment challenge, not scientific research.
cards.researchQuestion: What alternative engagement structures can enable creative studios to access specialized 3D motion design talent under regional salary constraints?
cards.quote: We want to hire a mid-level 3D motion designer but the three candidates we interviewed in the last six months all wanted Berlin-level salaries; we simply cannot close the gap on our current rates.

cards.why: Developing a feature set and threshold logic that differentiates gig worker behavioral patterns from actual fraud requires advanced machine learning and statistical modeling.
cards.researchQuestion: How can behavioral feature engineering and decision threshold optimization reduce false-positive rates in credit fraud detection for gig economy applicants without degrading true-positive performance?
cards.quote: Our fraud model was trained on roughly 18 months of data when we first deployed it in 2021.

cards.why: Investigating user abandonment across behavioral, psychological, and trust dimensions in open banking requires empirical human-computer interaction research.
cards.researchQuestion: What psychological and interface factors drive user abandonment during PSD2 open-banking consent flows among underbanked populations?
cards.quote: We do not think the product is broken; we think people do not understand what they are consenting to or what they get in return.

cards.why: Separating macroeconomic systematic risk from individual idiosyncratic borrower risk using panel data demands econometric modeling and statistical validation.
cards.researchQuestion: How can macroeconomic indicators and borrower-level panel data be integrated into an explainable credit risk model to separate systematic macroeconomic shock from idiosyncratic default probability?
cards.quote: We now have 41,000 closed loans with full repayment histories, originated between early 2019 and late 2024.

cards.why: Developing parallelised finite-element solvers and domain decomposition to achieve real-time performance requires advanced numerical methods and HPC research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can finite-element and finite-difference simulation solvers be parallelised and optimised via domain decomposition and GPU acceleration to achieve real-time execution on multi-core workstation servers?
cards.quote: Our digital-twin models for Italian factory clients run 15–20× slower than real time because the physics solvers aren't parallelised — operators can't use them for live decision support and three prospects declined for exactly this reason.

cards.why: Integrating vibration fatigue analysis into an existing mechanical digital twin is an engineering design task using established structural dynamics methods.
cards.researchQuestion: How can frequency-response analysis and variable-amplitude fatigue models be efficiently integrated into an existing mechanical digital twin for aerospace components?
cards.quote: A French aerospace supplier wants us to add vibration fatigue analysis to our mechanical digital twin, but we have no in-house expertise in structural dynamics — we'd need to either hire or partner fast because the tender closes in 90 days.

cards.why: Optimising WebGL rendering performance for large 3D meshes is an applied graphics engineering challenge rather than fundamental research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can progressive mesh loading and geometry compression formats be implemented in Three.js to enable smooth rendering of large-scale CAD models on low-memory client hardware?
cards.quote: We visualise simulation results in a 3D web viewer but rendering complex factory layouts with 200,000+ mesh elements crashes browsers on mid-range company laptops — about 40% of our end users can't view the full model.

cards.why: This is a regulatory compliance, standard interpretation, and business feasibility assessment rather than a research or engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What are the applicable EU regulatory frameworks and ergonomic standards for integrating worker posture assessment into industrial digital twins?
cards.quote: Our Slovenian clients are asking us to include a worker ergonomics assessment module in the digital twin — we know nothing about ergonomics standards and don't know whether this is an engineering or a medical problem.

cards.why: Developing structural calculation workflows for glulam connections relies on applying standard Eurocode rules rather than generating new scientific knowledge.
cards.researchQuestion: How can standard calculation workflows and templates for timber-frame glulam connections be integrated into daily engineering design practices according to Eurocode 5?
cards.quote: We are designing more timber-frame residential buildings because clients are asking for them, but our engineers trained on reinforced concrete and we keep having to outsource the structural calculations for glulam connections, which adds two to three weeks to each project and cuts our margin by about 18 percent.

cards.why: Streamlining masonry seismic vulnerability assessments is a software and workflow automation task using standard engineering evaluation guidelines.
cards.researchQuestion: How can rapid seismic vulnerability assessment procedures for unreinforced masonry buildings be systematised and partially automated to reduce manual engineering hours?
cards.quote: Several of our older buildings designed in the 1990s are now being sold or refinanced and banks are demanding seismic vulnerability assessments, but doing a full assessment by hand for a four-storey masonry building takes our senior engineer almost a week and we have a backlog of eleven buildings right now.

cards.why: This is a labor market, recruitment, and wage competitiveness challenge, not a research topic.
cards.researchQuestion: What recruitment and retention strategies can small regional engineering firms employ to compete with Western European salary offers?
cards.quote: We lost two experienced structural engineers in the last eighteen months to firms in Germany and Austria and cannot fill the positions locally; the salary we can offer is simply not competitive with what Western European firms advertise, even remotely.

cards.why: Developing an adaptive springback compensation model that accounts for tool wear and thermal variations in sheet metal bending involves applied material science and predictive modelling research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can real-time springback prediction and automated compensation models account for tooling wear and thermal fluctuations during sheet metal air bending?
cards.quote: We are cutting and bending 3 mm galvanized steel all day, and our press-brake operators are writing down bend angles by hand on paper sheets — we lose about 2 hours per shift just on rework because someone misread a spec or the worn tooling shifted the springback by 3–4 degrees. We need a way to compensate for springback automatically so first-part-good rate goes above 95%.

cards.why: Deploying electrical sub-metering hardware and energy monitoring systems is an engineering implementation task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can industrial sub-metering infrastructure and load-profiling techniques be deployed across multiple welding stations to identify peak energy consumption patterns?
cards.quote: We have 14 welding stations and our energy bill jumped 38% last year; we know TIG and MIG arcs draw a lot but we have no idea which stations or which parts of the shift are burning the most — we just get one monthly invoice from the utility and we can't justify a retooling plan without knowing where the waste is.

cards.why: This is a standard recruitment, skills gap, and staffing challenge rather than a research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What internal upskilling pathways and regional vocational partnerships can bridge the CAD/CAM programming skills gap for metal fabrication?
cards.quote: We want to hire two CNC programmers who know SolidWorks CAM but there is nobody with that profile in Zrenjanin, and the two candidates from Novi Sad we interviewed want salaries we simply cannot pay right now.

cards.why: Investigating ash inclusion mechanisms related to steel silicon content and chemical pre-treatments in hot-dip galvanizing requires metallurgical research.
cards.researchQuestion: What is the physicochemical mechanism of ash inclusion formation during hot-dip galvanizing of high-silicon steels, and how can pre-treatment fluxes prevent surface defects?
cards.quote: Our zinc-bath hot-dip galvanizing line produces a rough 'ash inclusion' surface defect on roughly 1 in 20 batches when the steel has higher silicon content; customers in the agricultural-equipment sector are rejecting those parts and we are taking a 12% scrap rate on affected runs.

cards.why: Reconstructing historical sociolinguistic registers and vernacular idioms in multi-lingual settings requires historical linguistics and sociolinguistic research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can early twentieth-century regional registers of Serbian and Hungarian in Vojvodina be authentically reconstructed for interactive historical fiction dialogue?
cards.quote: Our game is set in 1920s Vojvodina and we want the dialogue to feel period-authentic in both Serbian and Hungarian, but our playtesters say some phrases sound modern and out of place — we have no linguist on the team and Google Translate is clearly not good enough for this.

cards.why: Reconstructing 3D environment layouts from sparse archival photographs is a digital asset creation and procedural modeling task.
cards.researchQuestion: What photogrammetric and architectural reconstruction methods can accurately model interwar Central European vernacular buildings from sparse photographic archives?
cards.quote: We are building 3D environments based on real Vojvodina architecture from the interwar period — manor houses, mills, farmsteads — but we only have a handful of photographs and our environment artist is reconstructing layouts by guesswork, which slows us down badly.

cards.why: Developing bidirectional power-flow simulation and hosting capacity algorithms for high-penetration PV rural feeders requires electrical power systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can low-voltage distribution network planning algorithms be adapted to handle bidirectional power flow and stochastic voltage rise caused by high penetrations of rooftop photovoltaic systems?
cards.quote: We are connecting more and more small prosumer solar installations — sometimes 20 to 30 on a single rural LV feeder — and our field teams report voltage rising above 253 V at the far end of the feeder on sunny afternoons, which is causing nuisance tripping and complaints from neighbours who do not even have solar; our network planning tool was designed for one-way power flow and simply does not handle this.

cards.why: Calculating carbon footprints and adhering to ISO 14064 reporting standards is a corporate accounting and regulatory compliance task, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: What operational carbon accounting methodology complies with ISO 14064-1 for low-voltage electrical distribution and metering infrastructure?
cards.quote: We installed 18,000 smart meters in the last contract cycle and the utility is asking us to provide a report showing the carbon footprint of their entire low-voltage network operation — we have no methodology, no internal expertise, and the tender for the next phase explicitly requires an ISO 14064 compliant calculation.

cards.why: Developing probabilistic mapping and multi-sensor geophysical data fusion for locating legacy underground infrastructure involves spatial data science and signal processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multi-source historical utility records and electromagnetic pipe-locator data be fused into probabilistic spatial models to accurately predict legacy underground cable positions?
cards.quote: Our civil crews have to dig exploratory trenches to locate old underground cables before every excavation because the as-built drawings from the 1970s and 1980s are either missing or wrong by up to 4 metres — last year we had two cable strikes that cost us a combined 340,000 dinars in repairs and project delays.

cards.why: Commissioning lithium iron phosphate battery management systems and configuring protection relays is an advanced electrical engineering implementation task.
cards.researchQuestion: What practical training and hardware integration protocols enable electrical engineers to safely commission lithium iron phosphate battery management systems and protection relays?
cards.quote: We want to move into battery energy storage system (BESS) integration for industrial clients but we cannot find electricians or commissioning engineers in Vojvodina who have any hands-on experience with lithium iron phosphate battery management systems — the two people we tried to hire in the last six months both took offers in Germany.

cards.why: Redesigning emulsion architecture and water-activity control to extend cosmetic shelf life without exceeding preservative limits requires formulation chemistry research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can water-activity control and alternative emulsion architecture achieve a 24-month microbial and oxidative shelf life in natural cosmetic creams without exceeding EU preservative concentration limits?
cards.quote: Three of our best-selling moisturisers have a shelf life of only 14 months, which is too short for some German and Austrian distributors who need at least 24 months to cover their warehouse cycle. We've tried increasing the preservative load but it pushes us over the EU Cosmetics Regulation limits and changes the smell.

cards.why: Optimizing steam distillation kinetics, temperature profiles, and raw material pre-treatment for botanical extraction involves chemical engineering process research.
