cards.researchQuestion: How do raw material pre-treatment parameters and steam distillation temperature profiles influence essential oil yield and active compound extraction efficiency in lavender and chamomile processing?
cards.quote: We extract lavender and chamomile in-house using a 1980s steam-distillation vessel, and our yield is about 20% lower than benchmarks we see from Turkish and Bulgarian competitors. We suspect the raw material pre-treatment and distillation time profiles are suboptimal but we've never done a systematic study.

cards.why: Setting up in-vitro spectrophotometric SPF testing according to ISO standards is an analytical laboratory instrumentation and method setup task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can in-vitro spectrophotometric methods (ISO 24443) be established locally for preliminary sunscreen SPF evaluation using UV transmission analysis?
cards.quote: Our new sunscreen line needs SPF validation testing before we can put SPF 30 or SPF 50 on the label, and every accredited lab we've contacted in Serbia says they don't do in-vivo or in-vitro SPF testing — the nearest option is Budapest and they quoted us 9,000 EUR per SKU.

cards.why: Analyzing plastic injection moulding wall thickness and thermal warping using CAD/CAE tools is a polymer engineering application task.
cards.researchQuestion: How does wall thickness distribution affect thermal warping and sealing failure in injection-moulded polypropylene jar lids exposed to elevated temperatures?
cards.quote: We've seen a 30% rise in returns of our hand-cream jars from pharmacy chains because the injection-moulded PP lid warps in summer heat during transport, causing the seal to fail. Our packaging supplier says the tooling is fine but we think the wall thickness distribution is wrong.

cards.why: Designing high-efficiency power factor correction topologies that achieve extremely low THD under partial loads within strict space constraints requires advanced power electronics research.
cards.researchQuestion: What power electronic converter topologies and digital control strategies can reduce total harmonic distortion below 8% at partial loads in compact LED drivers without increasing PCB footprint?
searchTerms: power factor correction partial load THD
cards.quote: Our LED driver produces a total harmonic distortion of around 19% at partial load, which disqualifies us from EN 61000-3-2 Class C compliance and has already caused us to lose two Hungarian municipal tenders worth a combined €280,000; we need to reduce THD below 8% without increasing board size.

cards.why: Modelling plant photomorphogenesis and correlating spectral photon flux ratios with growth rates for specific crops involves agricultural and plant photobiology research.
cards.researchQuestion: How do dynamic red to far-red spectral photon flux ratios influence the growth kinetics and morphogenesis of leafy greens and fruiting crops in controlled environment agriculture?
cards.quote: We are developing an adaptive spectral tuning algorithm for grow-light applications that should adjust red/blue/far-red ratios based on a plant growth model, but none of our team has a biology background and we do not know which photomorphogenic parameters to optimise for or how to validate the model.

cards.why: Developing distributed scheduling algorithms and synchronisation control for resource-constrained embedded nodes involves computer science and distributed systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can distributed synchronisation and decentralized scheduling algorithms minimize flicker artifacts in resource-constrained embedded microcontrollers managing large lighting networks over RS-485?
cards.quote: Our luminaire controller runs a small Cortex-M4 MCU and needs to execute a local scheduling and dimming optimisation for up to 64 nodes; the current greedy algorithm causes visible flicker synchronisation artefacts at 3 a.m. low-load periods and we do not know how to formally model the problem.

cards.why: This is a financial accounting, bookkeeping setup, and compliance advisory task for EU grants, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: How should R&D cost accounting systems be structured to comply with Horizon Europe financial reporting and auditing standards?
cards.quote: We applied for a €150,000 Horizon Europe EIC Accelerator grant eight months ago and have heard nothing; our accountant says our books are not structured the way EU auditors expect and we may have to return pre-financing if we ever receive it.

cards.why: Developing demand-forecast and vehicle-loading optimization models under high seasonal demand volatility requires operations research and logistics modelling.
cards.researchQuestion: How can stochastic demand forecasting and bin-packing optimization models improve multi-route parcel allocation across fixed public transport transit schedules?
cards.quote: Bus schedules change seasonally and parcel volumes on each route swing by up to 60% week to week; right now the owner manually decides which parcels go on which bus the evening before, and we miss the optimal loading about 30% of the time, leaving capacity unused or making customers wait an extra day.

cards.why: Translating software UI strings and adapting to foreign customer service terminology is a software localization and translation task, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: What terminology standards and localization workflows ensure accurate German-language business and logistics UI implementation for courier platforms?
cards.quote: We have a small web shop integration but our tracking page is only in Serbian and Hungarian. We want to expand to B2B clients in Austria and Germany but we have no one to maintain a German-language customer interface and none of our three developers speak German.

cards.why: Reorganising a physical parcel sorting hub layout to resolve workflow crossing is an industrial engineering and facility layout planning task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can facility layout optimisation and material flow simulation resolve inbound and outbound crossing bottlenecks in micro-hub parcel sorting facilities?
cards.quote: At our Subotica hub we handle about 800 parcels a day and the floor space is 140 m². Congestion at the inbound belt slows throughput by about 25% during the 07:00–09:00 peak. We've looked at reorganising the floor but every layout we try on paper seems to make something else worse.

cards.why: Investigating aerodynamics, droplet dispersion, and drift reduction for agricultural spraying drones under crosswind conditions requires fluid dynamics and agricultural engineering research.
cards.researchQuestion: How do multirotor downwash aerodynamics and atmospheric crosswinds interact to cause droplet drift, and how can nozzle configuration and flight dynamics be optimized for drift reduction?
cards.quote: Our spraying drone deposits 80% of the target dose on average, but drift measurements on windy days (above 3 m/s) show we miss up to 35% of the intended strip, and one large client in Bačka is threatening to switch supplier after two suboptimal fungicide runs this spring.

cards.why: Developing automated prescription map generation algorithms that fuse multi-source soil, yield, and remote sensing data requires spatial data science and agronomic modelling research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automated multi-source data fusion of soil surveys, yield monitors, and satellite imagery generate reliable agronomic prescription maps with minimal manual intervention?
searchTerms: yield map soil survey spatial analysis
cards.quote: We have 14 agronomists on staff who write prescription maps manually by overlaying yield maps and soil surveys; this takes two to three days per farm per season and we simply cannot service more than 40 clients this way — we need to automate prescription generation.

cards.why: Building investor-grade financial models and scenario analysis for VC funding rounds is a corporate finance and financial advisory task, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: What financial modelling structures and cash-flow sensitivity scenarios satisfy venture capital requirements for Series A AgriTech portfolio companies?
cards.quote: We raised a Series A round 18 months ago but our investors are now pushing for a formal EBITDA improvement plan before the next tranche, and our internal finance team has no experience building the kind of three-year financial model with scenario analysis that the investors' term sheet requires.

cards.why: Improving fine-grained image classification accuracy for low-resolution, noisy field photographs of birds and insects requires computer vision and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can fine-grained visual classification models be adapted and retrained for low-resolution, unconstrained field photographs of birds and insects in natural environments?
cards.quote: Our nature-interpretation app lists 210 species but the automatic species identification from guest photos is wrong about 35% of the time for birds and insects, which embarrasses guides in front of guests and has led to three formal complaints from ornithologist clients this season.

cards.why: Developing localized carbon footprint accounting methodologies for eco-tourism packages with shared transport and regional supply chains requires environmental systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: What Life Cycle Assessment methodology accurately quantifies per-guest greenhouse gas emissions for multi-day eco-tourism packages utilizing shared transport and local supply chains?
cards.quote: We want to add a carbon-footprint score to each tour package so that sustainability-conscious agencies in the Netherlands and Scandinavia can use it in their own marketing, but we have no validated methodology for calculating transport, catering and accommodation emissions at the per-guest level.

cards.why: Navigating bureaucratic permitting processes and regulatory compliance for protected areas is an administrative and legal task, not research.
cards.researchQuestion: What administrative workflow and tracking systems optimize permit renewal compliance across multiple protected natural area jurisdictions?
searchTerms: dozvole za rad u zaštićenim područjima
cards.quote: Our trails cross three protected natural areas and getting annual permits renewed takes six to eight months of back-and-forth with provincial and national inspectorates — last year we lost the entire spring season on one trail because the permit renewal was delayed, costing us roughly €34,000 in cancelled bookings.

cards.why: Extracting spatial-temporal behavioural patterns from GPS track logs and photo timestamps to evaluate tourist engagement requires spatial data science and behavioural geography research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can GPS trajectory mining and timestamped photo metadata reveal spatial-temporal behavioural patterns and visitor engagement hotspots on guided nature trails?
cards.quote: We have GPS track logs from 4,800 guided tours over seven years but we use them only for navigation; we suspect there are patterns in where guests slow down, photograph and linger that could help us redesign tour itineraries and set better pricing tiers, but nobody on our team knows how to analyse spatial movement data.

cards.why: Determining genuine cell health versus deep discharge state in lithium-ion cells without destructive testing requires developing new non-invasive impedance or pulse-response electrochemical characterization methods.
cards.researchQuestion: How can rapid non-destructive pulse-discharge diagnostics distinguish between deeply discharged and genuinely degraded lithium-ion cells on industrial disassembly lines?
cards.quote: Our lithium-ion cell sorting relies on open-circuit voltage only and we're sending about 22% of still-usable cells to shredding because we can't distinguish genuinely degraded cells from ones that are just deeply discharged; this is destroying our margin on black mass recovery.

cards.why: Identifying telemetry dropouts involves diagnosing communication protocols, hardware faults, and signal coverage mapping rather than creating new scientific knowledge.
cards.researchQuestion: What is the optimal diagnostic framework for isolating cellular modem connectivity failures from firmware bugs and remote coverage gaps in distributed IoT sensor networks?
cards.quote: Our collection point cabinets run on 4G and we're seeing about 8% of fill-level and weight sensor readings drop out every week; we don't know if it's the modems, the firmware or network coverage gaps, and we're making wrong collection decisions as a result.

cards.why: Optimizing manual disassembly workflow is an industrial engineering and ergonomic time-and-motion study rather than a research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can manual e-waste disassembly workstations be ergonomically and procedurally redesigned to increase throughput efficiency without expanding headcount?
cards.quote: Disassembly output per worker has stayed flat at around 18 kg/hour for two years; we've watched the workflow but don't know how to redesign the station layout or the sequence of operations to get closer to the 28 kg/hour our Dutch partner achieves.

cards.why: This is purely a human resources, salary budgeting, and talent retention challenge rather than a technical or scientific problem.
cards.researchQuestion: What alternative employment or collaborative models can sustainably secure embedded systems engineering capacity for an SME under regional budget constraints?
cards.quote: We want to hire two experienced electronics engineers to build an in-house testing bench but the salaries candidates are asking for in Novi Sad are above what we budgeted, and the ones we can afford keep leaving for larger firms in Belgrade after six months.

cards.why: Analyzing transient thermal-mechanical contact stress and surface-fatigue spalling under rapid directional reversals requires advanced tribology and finite element simulation research.
cards.researchQuestion: What is the dominant mechanism of surface-fatigue spalling in planetary gear output stages subjected to high-frequency rapid directional reversals?
cards.quote: We're seeing surface-fatigue spalling on the output gear of our RA-40 planetary gearbox after about 9,000 operating hours — our design spec says 20,000 — and it only happens in installations where the robot makes frequent rapid direction reversals, not in continuous-duty applications.

cards.why: Correlating existing dimensional measurements with machine tool usage logs is a data integration and predictive maintenance application task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multivariate statistical process control link dimensional borehole measurement data with cutting insert wear states to enable condition-based maintenance?
cards.quote: We machine about 1,200 actuator housings per month and our scrap rate on the final bore tolerance is running at 4.1%, up from 1.8% two years ago; we think tool wear is the root cause but we haven't been able to prove it because we don't log tool age systematically.

cards.why: Learning and implementing standard automotive quality documentation frameworks like PPAP is an administrative and procedural compliance task rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What structured project management methodology best prepares a precision machining SME for automotive PPAP level 3 compliance without external consulting overextension?
cards.quote: A large German robotics OEM has asked us to supply 4,000 units per year with PPAP documentation; we've never done PPAP before and our quality manager estimates it will take eight months just to understand what's required, which is too slow for the customer's timeline.

cards.why: Deconvoluting thermal contributions from hydrodynamic lubricant churning losses versus boundary seal friction requires rigorous thermodynamic and rheological investigation.
cards.researchQuestion: How do altered base-oil formulations decouple hydrodynamic churning losses from shaft seal friction to drive operating temperature elevations in sealed gearboxes?
cards.quote: Our lubricant supplier changed the base-oil formulation last year and now our sealed gearboxes are showing elevated operating temperatures — up 11°C on average — but we can't tell whether the thermal problem is in the lubricant viscosity, the seal friction, or both.

cards.why: Overcoming performance ceilings in extreme class-imbalance churn prediction requires advanced machine learning algorithm design or synthetic data generation techniques.
cards.researchQuestion: What advanced machine learning architectures or cost-sensitive learning strategies can improve recall in highly imbalanced telecommunications churn prediction datasets beyond current gradient boosting limits?
cards.quote: Our churn-prediction model for a telecom client tops out at 71% recall, and every percentage point we miss costs the client roughly €180,000 in lost revenue per quarter — we've tried XGBoost and basic neural nets but we're stuck.

cards.why: Selecting currency hedging instruments and establishing corporate treasury policies is financial administration and commercial banking rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What currency hedging strategies and instruments are appropriate for small cross-border software consultancies with asymmetric currency cash flows?
cards.quote: We invoice in euros but pay salaries in dinars; with the exchange rate moving 8% in six months our margin forecast was off by nearly a full point and the board is asking us to hedge, which none of us knows how to do properly.

cards.why: Drafting data processing agreements and transfer impact assessments for GDPR compliance is legal paperwork and compliance advisory rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What legal framework standardizes GDPR Article 28 data processing agreements and transfer impact assessments for software vendors operating outside EU adequacy jurisdictions?
cards.quote: Clients in Germany and Austria are now asking for a data-processing agreement and a transfer-impact assessment before they sign; our standard contract template is Serbian law and we have no one in-house who can produce the EU-compliant paperwork fast enough.

cards.why: Designing a real-time multi-warehouse inventory allocation engine capable of handling extreme promotional demand spikes requires advanced operations research and demand forecasting algorithms.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multi-echelon inventory allocation models dynamically rebalance regional stock in near-real-time under anticipated promotional demand surges?
cards.quote: We have a logistics client running 14 regional warehouses and they want a real-time inventory allocation engine, but order volumes spike 4x during promotions and our current rule-based system can't rebalance fast enough — we need something that plans ahead.

cards.why: Investigating polymer deformation mechanisms and developing dimensionally stable composite turbine blades for high-humidity medical devices requires materials science and polymer engineering research.
cards.researchQuestion: What polymer material formulations and injection moulding parameters prevent moisture-induced dimensional warping in polycarbonate turbine blades exposed to high humidity cycles?
cards.quote: We are seeing a 15% return rate on our flagship SP-400 spirometer because the plastic turbine blades warp slightly after about 800 measurement cycles at high humidity; the deformation is under 0.3 mm but it shifts flow calibration enough to trigger out-of-spec results.

cards.why: Automating clinical report generation by integrating reference equations into existing software architecture is a software engineering and database integration task.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automated longitudinal trend analysis algorithms be integrated into legacy desktop medical software to compute age- and height-adjusted respiratory reference norms?
cards.quote: Our occupational health clients want an automated report comparing a worker's spirometry trend over three years against age- and height-adjusted reference norms; right now a technician does this manually for each patient and it takes about 12 minutes per report, adding up to nearly 30 hours of labour per week.

cards.why: Building an effective production scheduler for a mixed-model assembly line is an industrial engineering and operations management task.
cards.researchQuestion: What heuristic scheduling methods minimize finished goods inventory and SKU stockouts in mixed-model low-volume medical device assembly lines?
cards.quote: We assemble 200 to 300 units per month on a mixed-model line with three operators, but scheduling which variant to build on which shift is done on paper and we routinely end up with stockouts on one SKU and overstock on another, tying up roughly €40,000 in unnecessary inventory.

cards.why: Determining the root causes of allele dropout across biological sample collection, storage kinetics, and DNA extraction protocols requires molecular biology experimentation.
cards.researchQuestion: How do saliva sample collection tube chemistries, ambient transport delays, and extraction protocols interact to cause allele dropout in multiplex PCR genotyping?
cards.quote: Our CYP2C19 and CYP2D6 panel works well in the lab, but we're getting allele dropout in about 3% of samples with degraded DNA — typically saliva collected at pharmacy kiosks — and we don't yet understand whether it's the extraction protocol, the PCR design, or the sample transport conditions.

cards.why: Optimizing bioinformatics software pipelines for computational speed and cloud cost reduction is software engineering and algorithm profiling.
cards.researchQuestion: What algorithmic profiling and workflow optimization strategies minimize cloud compute costs and execution times for short-read sequencing star-allele calling pipelines?
cards.quote: Our bioinformatics pipeline for calling star alleles from short-read sequencing data takes 4–6 hours per batch of 24 samples on our current cloud setup, which costs us about 9 EUR per sample in compute — that's killing our margin at the price point pharmacies will pay.

cards.why: Designing effective health communication interfaces for patients to comprehend complex pharmacogenomic test results requires empirical human-computer interaction and health literacy research.
cards.researchQuestion: What digital health interface designs and plain-language translations effectively communicate complex pharmacogenomic test results to patients without clinical literacy?
cards.quote: We want to explain our test results to patients in plain language through a mobile app, but our current PDF reports are written for physicians — in user testing, 7 out of 10 patients said they didn't understand what the result meant for them.

cards.why: Understanding and mitigating fiber breakage mechanics during mechanical hammer-mill decortication requires mechanical engineering and materials processing research.
cards.researchQuestion: What mechanical design modifications in hammer-mill decorticators minimize bast fiber breakage and preserve long-line hemp fiber yield?
cards.quote: Our decortication line damages long fibres, which lowers the price we get.

cards.why: Reverse-engineering proprietary tractor CAN bus message structures across different manufacturers is an embedded systems engineering and protocol analysis task.
cards.researchQuestion: What automated bus monitoring and protocol decoding workflows can accelerate the development of ISOBUS tractor-implement CAN adapters for diverse agricultural machinery models?
cards.quote: Our ISOBUS terminals currently support only four tractor brands via proprietary CAN bus adapters, and dealers keep losing sales because the terminal won't talk to Belarusian MTZ and Chinese YTO tractors that dominate the Serbian market below 100 HP — reverse-engineering every new variant is costing us three to four months per model.

cards.why: Translating remote sensing vegetation indices and crop sensor data into agronomic fertilizer rate correction models requires agricultural science and agronomy research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multi-spectral vegetation indices and in-season crop sensor data be algorithmically translated into agronomically sound variable-rate nitrogen prescription maps?
cards.quote: Our variable-rate application maps are built from soil sampling data that is often two to three years old, and the actual within-season crop response to fertiliser varies a lot — we want to incorporate current-season plant sensing data so the controller adjusts rates based on what the crop actually needs right now.

cards.why: Evaluating regulatory conformity and technical file gaps against EU machinery legislation is legal compliance and safety engineering consulting rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What technical documentation and risk assessment adaptations are required for agricultural electronic controllers to comply with EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230?
cards.quote: We want to enter the German market this year but our largest dealer there told us we need to show conformity with the new EU machinery regulation 2023/1230 before they will list us — our legal team in Serbia doesn't have EU machinery law experience and external EU counsel is quoting us €35,000 just for the gap analysis.

cards.why: Developing time-series anomaly detection algorithms to identify slow equipment calibration drift in noisy agricultural sensor streams requires data science and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: What time-series anomaly detection models can identify slow sensor calibration drift in multivariate agricultural equipment telemetry streams prior to harvest yield loss?
cards.quote: We log 180 gigabytes of field operation data per month from 340 active terminals but we have no way to detect when a controller is behaving abnormally — a miscalibrated flow sensor can under-apply nitrogen for an entire season before anyone notices, and by then the yield damage is done.

cards.why: Creating automated alert ranking and clustering models from historical security information event management data requires machine learning and cybersecurity analytics research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can active learning and alert clustering algorithms reduce false positive alert volumes in managed security operations centres without missing confirmed incidents?
cards.quote: Our analysts are drowning in alerts — we get roughly 4,200 SIEM events per day per client and maybe 12 of those are real; we need a way to rank and cluster alerts automatically so the team isn't spending 80% of their shift chasing noise.

cards.why: Extracting structured threat intelligence indicators from informal, mixed-script, multi-lingual regional dark-web forums requires natural language processing and text mining research.
cards.researchQuestion: What natural language processing pipelines extract structured threat intelligence indicators from informal, mixed-script South Slavic forum and dark-web discussions?
cards.quote: We want to offer clients a threat-intelligence feed tailored to Serbian and regional threat actors, but extracting structured indicators from Serbian-language dark-web forums and local hacker communities is something none of our analysts have time for.

cards.why: Performing regulatory gap assessments for EU directives transposed into domestic law is legal consulting and compliance auditing rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What compliance mapping framework aligns EU NIS2 directive requirements with domestic transposition legislation and technical audit controls for critical infrastructure?
cards.quote: Three of our largest potential clients — a bank, an energy distributor, and a hospital — are asking for NIS2 compliance gap assessments before they sign contracts, and we don't have a lawyer on staff who understands both the EU directive text and Serbian transposition law.

cards.why: Developing context-aware static code analysis warning prioritization models using historical software defect data requires software engineering and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can historical defect data and code context features be combined to rank static analysis warnings along safety-critical execution paths in automotive software?
cards.quote: Our static code analysis pipeline flags about 900 warnings per release and our team spends roughly 60% of sprint time triaging them manually; we need a way to rank which warnings actually matter for safety-critical paths so we can cut that effort in half.

cards.why: Implementing standard ISO 26262 functional safety processes and HARA analysis for commercial certification is engineering management and quality assurance consulting rather than research.
cards.researchQuestion: What agile implementation methodology integrates ISO 26262 ASIL-B functional safety lifecycle processes into small automotive software development teams?
cards.quote: Our biggest German customer now requires ISO 26262 ASIL-B certification for the brake-assist module by Q3 next year, and we have no one in-house who has run a full functional safety process before; we are looking at hiring a consultant but the quotes we have received are between €120,000 and €180,000, which is too much for our size.

cards.why: Developing lightweight, cost-effective software-in-the-loop or virtualized HIL testing alternatives that meet real-time simulation accuracy requirements involves embedded systems research.
cards.researchQuestion: What virtualized software-in-the-loop simulation architectures can replace hardware-in-the-loop test benches for low-budget automotive control platforms without sacrificing real-time timing accuracy?
cards.quote: Our HIL test bench runs on a single dSPACE MicroAutoBox that cost us €55,000; when we take on smaller vehicle platform projects the bench setup cost alone kills the margin and clients walk away.

cards.why: Developing aggressive time-series data compression and tiered statistical aggregation strategies for resource-constrained local databases requires database systems and data compression research.
cards.researchQuestion: What aggressive time-series compression and hierarchical downsampling algorithms maintain analytical query performance for high-frequency agricultural sensor data under strict on-premise hardware constraints?
cards.quote: One of our agri-food clients collects temperature, humidity and CO₂ readings every five minutes across 22 storage silos, but the time-series database is growing at 40 GB per month and our queries for monthly reports already take 45 minutes — we can't afford cloud and need a smarter on-premise approach.

cards.why: Designing adaptive online learning or concept-drift mitigation models for industrial fermentation prediction across variable grain batches requires machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: What adaptive online learning algorithms or domain adaptation techniques prevent model drift in batch fermentation endpoint prediction when raw material properties vary?
cards.quote: The brewery client wants a dashboard that predicts fermentation completion time within ±2 hours, but fermentation curves shift with each new grain batch and our fixed regression model drifts badly after about three batches without manual recalibration.

cards.why: Hiring temporary technical staff or engaging subcontractors to cover maternity leave and active commercial delivery deadlines is a business management and operational task.
cards.researchQuestion: What subcontracting frameworks and talent sourcing channels effectively maintain project delivery continuity for micro-consultancies facing key personnel absences?
cards.quote: We only have two people who can write code and one of them is Milica who is going on maternity leave; we have three active contracts and won't be able to deliver all of them on time — we need to either hire or subcontract within the next six weeks.

cards.why: It involves building an internal automation tool to parse files and populate templates rather than discovering new scientific knowledge.
cards.researchQuestion: How can unstructured instrument output files and spectral data be automatically parsed to pre-populate compliant chemical analysis reports?
cards.quote: What we need is something more modular—ideally a tool or a workflow that can parse our instrument output files, flag key peaks, and pre-populate a structured report template

cards.why: It requires investigating and testing novel solvent compatibilities with sensitive ring-forming reactions to solve a chemical synthesis problem.
cards.researchQuestion: Which green solvents can replace halogenated hydrocarbons in sensitive beta-lactam extraction and purification stages without compromising yield or purity?
cards.quote: The beta-lactam ring is sensitive and we have not been able to confirm whether those solvents are compatible with the specific temperature and pH conditions in our routes without running a proper screening programme.

cards.why: This is a grant writing and administrative application task rather than a research or technical challenge.
cards.researchQuestion: How can technical data for a protected amino acid synthesis line be structured into a compliant national innovation grant application?
cards.quote: The FREN INOVACIJE fund looks like the right mechanism to finance that scale-up, but the application requires a detailed project budget in a specific format, a technical feasibility section, and an impact narrative that we have no experience writing.

cards.why: Solving mixed-language legal and accounting terminology mapping requires advanced natural language processing and multilingual information retrieval techniques.
cards.researchQuestion: How can multilingual information retrieval systems accurately map and search accounting and legal terminology across mixed-language corpora containing Slovenian and German?
cards.quote: The problem is that these files mix Slovenian and German freely: a Slovenian accountant writing to an Austrian supplier might use 'DDV' in one sentence and 'Mehrwertsteuer' in the next, both meaning the same tax concept.

cards.why: It involves standard software engineering data migration and building deterministic ETL scripts to handle legacy database formats.
cards.researchQuestion: What robust ETL pipeline architecture can automatically normalize and migrate heterogeneous legacy desktop database formats into modern cloud accounting platforms?
cards.quote: In practice every annual backup from 2008 to 2016 uses a slightly different field structure, some years have attachments stored as relative paths that no longer resolve, and two years of data were exported from an intermediate system that added its own non-standard columns.

cards.why: Evaluating cognitive impacts and validating educational game mechanics on mathematical reasoning requires pedagogical research and experimental design.
cards.researchQuestion: To what extent do manipulative board game mechanics improve mathematical reasoning and arithmetic performance among primary school children?
cards.quote: Before we can approach the Ministry of Education about any kind of broader rollout or endorsement, we need to be able to show that the kit actually builds mathematical reasoning in a measurable way.

cards.why: It is an industrial design and material science challenge regarding moisture barriers and alternative paperboard laminates for packaging durability.
cards.researchQuestion: How can low-cost moisture-barrier coatings or alternative paperboard stocks prevent component warping in humid environments without exceeding cost limits?
cards.quote: By the end of October, teachers reported that game boards were warping badly — corners lifting, cards bowing — and in three of the five schools the components were not flat enough to play with.

cards.why: Fine-tuning or adapting speech recognition models for children speaking Serbian with high accuracy is a challenging speech processing research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can automatic speech recognition acoustic and language models be optimized for low-latency, low-error recognition of math problem reading by young children speaking South Slavic languages?
cards.quote: The models struggled most with Serbian number words spoken by younger children, particularly numbers above twenty, and they frequently misrecognised short function words that carry the actual mathematical meaning of a sentence.

cards.why: Developing robust low-data statistical testing frameworks like advanced Bayesian methods or variance reduction for sparse e-commerce traffic is a rigorous statistical research topic.
cards.researchQuestion: How can Bayesian inference models and variance reduction techniques reliably accelerate A/B testing statistical power in low-traffic e-commerce settings?
cards.quote: We need a way to extract a reliable signal from small samples within a defined test window, and ideally a method we can explain plainly to a shop owner, not just to a statistician.

cards.why: It involves software pipeline development and heuristic UI pattern matching to process event analytics data streams.
cards.researchQuestion: What algorithmic heuristics can automatically detect and cluster UI drop-off patterns from large-scale user session replays and clickstream heatmaps?
cards.quote: What we actually need is something that looks at the combination of signals — where people click, how far they scroll, where they exit — and surfaces the two or three UI patterns that are most likely causing a drop-off on that specific page type.

cards.why: This is a legal compliance review and contractual documentation task rather than a technical or scientific problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How must data-processing agreements be structured to comply with GDPR Article 28 requirements for cross-border SaaS vendors serving the DACH market?
cards.quote: GDPR Article 28 requires a written data-processing addendum between a controller and any processor handling personal data on their behalf. We have a template we drafted in 2022 with help from a local lawyer who handles mostly contract and employment law.

cards.why: Perception and 3D vision reconstruction of transparent, specular, or reflective objects from sparse point clouds require computer vision and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can 3D pose estimation pipelines accurately reconstruct transparent and specular objects from sparse depth camera point clouds for robotic bin-picking?
searchTerms: robotic bin picking for transparent parts
cards.quote: Clear polypropylene caps, glass vials, and polished steel shaft ends either scatter the structured light or let it pass straight through, so we end up with a cloud that has maybe a few hundred points where we need several thousand to localize the pick pose confidently.

cards.why: This is a regulatory certification compliance and auditing procedure rather than a research or engineering investigation.
cards.researchQuestion: What engineering and documentation roadmap is required to achieve IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity certification for collaborative robot end-effectors?
cards.quote: The sticking point is IEC 62443, specifically the certification of our device as a component that can sit on a secured industrial control network. We understand why they require it — a robot on the shop-floor network is a real attack surface — but our current product was not designed with that certification in mind.

cards.why: Developing real-time graph search and collision-aware motion planning algorithms for sparse, unstructured bin geometries is an advanced robotics research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: How can motion planning and heuristic search algorithms be optimized for real-time collision-free pick sequence generation in sparse bin-picking scenarios?
cards.quote: As the bin empties, the remaining parts shift into random orientations, and the number of candidate pick poses the planner has to evaluate grows quickly. Right now the planner falls back to an exhaustive search over those candidates combined with collision checking against the bin walls and the robot arm configuration.

cards.why: Investigating radio frequency propagation and multipath fading inside reinforced concrete structures requires wireless communications research.
cards.researchQuestion: How do indoor radio propagation characteristics and multipath interference affect 868 MHz LoRaWAN packet delivery rates within reinforced-concrete industrial environments?
searchTerms: packet loss in wireless sensor networks
cards.quote: Once the nodes go inside thick-walled structures we see packet loss of 12 to 18 percent. Customers monitor sensor dashboards and they are noticing gaps of 10 to 20 minutes where readings simply disappear.

cards.why: Porting firmware and RTOS startup code to a new microcontroller architecture is an embedded software engineering task.
cards.researchQuestion: What is the systematic process for porting a FreeRTOS-based embedded firmware stack to a novel RISC-V microcontroller architecture and toolchain?
cards.quote: We have been trying to port our FreeRTOS-based firmware for six weeks and we are still not past the startup code and interrupt controller. The RTOS vendor does not have an official port for this specific chip...

cards.why: This is an administrative and regulatory compliance preparation task rather than a technical or scientific investigation.
cards.researchQuestion: What documentation and audit preparation framework is necessary for small-scale electronics manufacturers pursuing IEC 62443-4-2 certification?
cards.quote: We have never gone through an IEC 62443 certification process. We do not know which audit bodies operate in the EU and are accredited for this standard, what the typical cost and timeline look like...

cards.why: Applying statistical process modeling and design of experiments to identify multifactorial drift in industrial coating is a process engineering research problem.
cards.researchQuestion: Which combination of environmental and operational parameters drives coating thickness variation and weight failure rates in pharmaceutical pan coaters?
searchTerms: design of experiments in film coating
cards.quote: We have looked at each parameter individually and we cannot see a clear pattern. The failures seem to cluster in certain months, which makes us think humidity or seasonal air quality plays a role, but we have not been able to confirm that.

cards.why: Formulating polymer matrix capsules and conducting dissolution testing is standard applied pharmaceutical technology and product development.
cards.researchQuestion: How can HPMC and ethylcellulose polymer matrix excipients be formulated to achieve sustained-release dissolution profiles for ibuprofen 400 mg capsules?
cards.quote: The problem is that our formulation team — three experienced pharmacists and two technicians — has mainly worked with immediate-release solid-dose forms. We have never designed a polymer matrix for controlled release...

cards.why: Integrating commercial packaging serialization hardware with enterprise resource planning software is standard IT systems integration work.
cards.researchQuestion: What middleware architecture can cost-effectively integrate packaging serialization hardware with SAP ERP systems for pharmaceutical compliance?
cards.quote: What we need is a verified integration between our serialisation hardware — Zebra printers and a camera-based verification unit already installed on Line 2 — and our SAP ECC 6.0 system so that every saleable unit gets a unique identifier...

cards.why: Developing dynamic adaptive learning algorithms and personalized content recommendation models requires educational data science and machine learning research.
cards.researchQuestion: How can collaborative filtering and machine learning models dynamically personalize learning paths in enterprise LMS platforms to improve learner retention?
cards.quote: Our adaptive engine is basically a rule-based system that slots each learner into one of four difficulty tiers — beginner, elementary, intermediate, advanced — based on their score on an entry quiz.

cards.why: Extracting valid pedagogical competency gains from complex clickstream activity logs requires advanced educational data mining and psychometric modeling.
cards.researchQuestion: What learning analytics frameworks can reliably predict true competency gains from xAPI clickstream activity logs in digital learning environments?
cards.quote: The problem is we do not know what to do with it. We ran some basic completion-rate reports and presented them to two clients last spring, and both asked the obvious question: does finishing a module actually mean the person learned something?

cards.why: This is an international business expansion, tax registration, and legal structuring challenge rather than a research or engineering topic.

card.jointProblem: Suncokret Eko d.o.o. and Đorđe Vukelić can collaborate to optimize slow-pyrolysis process parameters for agricultural residues to reach over 70% fixed carbon while preserving commercially viable mass yields. Together, they can bridge the gap between laboratory-derived temperature-residence-time optimization models and industrial-scale production requirements.

claims.text: Đorđe Vukelić produced wheat straw biochar in a laboratory fixed-bed tube furnace at final temperatures from 300 to 700 °C, observing that fixed carbon content increased from 38 to 72 wt% while biochar yield decreased from 39.2% to 24.7%.

A central composite design applied to fixed-bed slow pyrolysis of corn stover mapped responses including biochar yield, fixed carbon content, and BET surface area across pyrolysis temperatures and residence times.

The project led by Vukelić systematically mapped the pyrolysis parameter space—temperature, residence time, and feedstock type—for Vojvodina agricultural residues, producing over 200 characterised biochar samples and a decision-support matrix.
Vukelić holds a granted patent for a process to produce certified-grade biochar from sunflower husk by controlled slow pyrolysis with integrated temperature-residence-time feedback.

gaps: Vukelić is currently committed at roughly 0.8 FTE research capacity due to PYROLINK obligations and a full teaching load.

card.jointProblem: FlexiPack Solutions d.o.o. and Snežana Puzović can investigate the polymer structural parameters and layer interaction mechanisms that cause oxygen transmission rates to rise at elevated temperatures in mono-material PE films. By combining industrial batch data with permeability characterisation expertise, they can diagnose the root cause of the barrier drop.

claims.text: Snežana Puzović coextruded amorphous PET plies with LLDPE in five-layer configurations to explore moderate barrier requirements without requiring separate recycling streams.

Puzović measured oxygen transmission rate across a temperature range of 5 °C to 50 °C on LLDPE films of various densities, constructing Arrhenius plots and calculating activation energies for permeation.

The MONOBAR project led by Puzović investigated the feasibility of replacing conventional EVOH-containing multilayer films with all-polyolefin or compatibilised structures, characterising oxygen and water vapour transport mechanisms across temperature and humidity ranges.
Puzović is the inventor of a pending patent for a coextruded five-layer film structure comprising an amorphous polyethylene terephthalate barrier ply and polyolefin skin layers.

gaps: Puzović is available for new collaborations from autumn 2026 onwards due to finishing commitments tied to the MONOBAR project.

card.jointProblem: Mina Kecman and Agrosan IoT can develop an empirically validated sizing methodology tailored to Serbian winter insolation patterns and lead-acid battery constraints, replacing the company's manual calculations. This collaboration will enable Agrosan to accurately re-dimension their autonomous agricultural IoT stations and prevent power failures during prolonged cloudy periods.

claims.text: Mina Kecman's research group focuses on energy yield modelling for photovoltaic systems, battery storage dimensioning for off-grid and remote installations, and long-term solar resource assessment.
She has provided sizing consultancy for two small companies installing off-grid monitoring systems for agricultural and environmental applications in Serbia.

She authored a study presenting a deterministic iterative sizing procedure for lead-acid battery storage in stand-alone PV systems using synthetic hourly irradiance sequences and loss-of-load probability (LOLP).

She served as principal investigator on a project that developed and validated an integrated methodology for characterising solar irradiance resources and sizing battery storage for small stand-alone PV systems in the Pannonian Plain.

card.jointProblem: Labos Dijagnostika and Nikola Bulatović can collaborate to evaluate and adjust the antimicrobial susceptibility testing breakpoints and interpretive criteria used for Enterococcus strains from poultry farms. By utilizing archived poultry isolates and expertise in broth microdilution and EUCAST frameworks, they can resolve inconclusive diagnostic results and improve veterinary diagnostics.

claims.text: Nikola Bulatović has research experience focusing on antimicrobial resistance phenotyping and genotyping in livestock-associated Enterococcus faecalis and Enterococcus faecium, applying EUCAST clinical breakpoints and epidemiological cut-off values.

A book chapter co-authored by Bulatović discusses practical and interpretive challenges in applying EUCAST clinical breakpoints and epidemiological cut-off values to Enterococcus spp. isolated from food-producing animals, including broth microdilution methods and the limited availability of veterinary-specific breakpoints.

Bulatović led a cross-border surveillance project work package responsible for microbiological methods harmonisation, ensuring partner laboratories used identical broth microdilution panels and applied EUCAST ECOFF values consistently.
Bulatović serves as principal investigator on a national research project addressing the genomic epidemiology of transferable antimicrobial resistance in food-animal Enterococcus spp. in Serbia.

gaps: The VETO-AMR project absorbs a significant share of research time, and new project commitments starting before mid-2026 may be limited.

card.jointProblem: The company and the researcher can collaborate to integrate progressive mesh loading and geometry compression into their Three.js web viewer to handle large CAD models smoothly. This will enable users on mid-range laptops with integrated graphics to render complex factory layouts without browser crashes.

claims.text: Ksenija Čolić's research group focuses on adaptive level-of-detail algorithms, progressive mesh transmission protocols, and GPU-accelerated rendering pipelines running in browser environments using WebGL.
She studied streaming compressed mesh data over HTTP/1.1 using chunk-based delta encoding to deliver progressive meshes without requiring persistent TCP connections.
Her team developed a pipeline decomposing terrain meshes into a progressive bitstream for browser delivery with view-dependent refinement ordering.
She led a project developing a complete pipeline from raw meshes to a streaming WebGL viewer with variable-detail delivery keyed to network conditions.
